data.title: VisionWave Holdings, Inc. Announces Closing of $2.0 Million Registered Direct Offering
data.description:
WEST HOLLYWOOD, Calif., Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- VisionWave Holdings, Inc. (the “Company”), a technology company focused on advanced defense, autonomous systems and related technologies, today announced the closing of its previously announced registered direct offering with institutional investors for the purchase and sale of approximately $2.0 million of shares of Common Stock (or pre-funded warrants in lieu thereof) together with accompanying investor warrants at a price of $0.19 per Common Unit.

The offering consisted of the sale of 10,526,313 Common Units (or Pre-Funded Units), each consisting of (i) one (1) share of Common Stock or one (1) Pre-Funded Warrant and (ii) one (1) Registered Common Warrant to purchase one (1) share of Common Stock per warrant at an exercise price of $0.57. The public offering price per Common Unit was $0.19 (or $0.18 for each Pre-Funded Unit, which is equal to the public offering price per Common Unit sold in the offering minus an exercise price of $0.01 per Pre-Funded Warrant). The Pre-Funded Warrants are immediately exercisable and may be exercised at any time until exercised in full. For each Pre-Funded Unit sold in the offering, the number of Common Units in the offering was decreased on a one-for-one basis. The initial exercise price of each Common Warrant is $0.57 per share of Common Stock or pursuant to an alternative cashless exercise option. The Common Warrants are exercisable immediately and expire 60 months after the initial issuance date.

Aggregate gross proceeds to the Company were approximately $2.0 million. The Company expects to use the net proceeds from the offering, together with its existing cash, for general corporate purposes, including partial repayment of the convertible debenture issued by the Company to YA II PN, Ltd. in the original principal amount of $10,000,000 on July 20, 2026 and working capital.

Following the closing of the offering, and after the exercise in full of the Pre-Funded Warrants issued in the offering and the issuance of 9,313,157 shares of Common Stock upon the exercise of certain Common Warrants, the Company has 41,260,663 shares of Common Stock issued and outstanding.

The Company has agreed not to issue shares of Common Stock under its standby equity purchase agreement for 30 days following the closing of the offering, and its outstanding convertible notes may not be converted during that period.

Aegis Capital Corp. acted as exclusive placement agent for the offering. Sheppard, Mullin, Richter & Hampton LLP acted as counsel to the Company. Kaufman & Canoles, P.C. acted as counsel to Aegis Capital Corp.

The registered direct offering was made pursuant to an effective shelf registration statement on Form S-3 (No. 333-297939) previously filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) and declared effective by the SEC on September 1, 2026. A final prospectus supplement and accompanying prospectus describing the terms of the offering have been filed with the SEC and are available on the SEC’s website located at www.sec.gov. Electronic copies of the final prospectus supplement and the accompanying prospectus may be obtained by contacting Aegis Capital Corp., Attention: Syndicate Department, 1345 Avenue of the Americas, 27th floor, New York, NY 10105, by email at syndicate@aegiscap.com, or by telephone at +1 (212) 813-1010.

This press release shall not constitute an offer to sell or the solicitation of an offer to buy nor shall there be any sale of these securities in any state or jurisdiction in which such offer, solicitation or sale would be unlawful prior to registration or qualification under the securities laws of any such state or jurisdiction.

About VisionWave Holdings, Inc.

VisionWave Holdings, Inc. is a technology company developing dual-use unmanned systems, autonomous capabilities, and advanced sensing solutions for defense, security, and commercial applications. Its portfolio includes the VARAN unmanned ground vehicle (UGV) platform and a suite of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and drone solutions, supported by sensing, perception, and autonomy technologies. Through technology development and strategic partnerships, VisionWave aims to deliver integrated ground and aerial systems that enhance situational awareness, support operational missions, and reduce personnel exposure to risk across military and civilian environments. data.title: CORPWATCH: Panama Canal re-auctions 66 transit slots unsold at first Panamax sale
data.description:
The Panama Canal will re-auction 66 transit slots that went unsold at its first long-term sale for the Panamax locks, the waterway's operator said on November 26.

The Panama Canal Authority (ACP) said 13 reconfigured packages holding the 66 slots will go on the block on December 3, between 10:00am and 11:50am Panama time, in staggered 30-minute cycles, one for each type of package. Of the slots on offer, 36 are for northbound transits and 30 for southbound ones, and all carry booking dates between January 3 and April 3, 2027.

That leaves almost a quarter of the capacity the canal ringfenced for its newest booking product without a buyer. The pilot put 51 packages and 288 slots on the market when it launched, so the 66 going back out represent 23% of the total - a thin first result for a scheme designed to let shippers lock in passage through the months when water availability constrains how many ships the canal can handle.

The leftover packages have been reconfigured and will be sold again under the same rules, requirements and benefits set out in the programme's terms and conditions, the authority said. The first round, on November 24, used a sealed-bid competition with the same allocation mechanism and award criteria as the canal's existing Neopanamax scheme.

The Panamax pilot brought the canal's original, smaller locks into its Long-Term Slot Allocation programme for the first time, alongside 270 Neopanamax slots offered for the same dry season. Both sets work out at three transits a day across the January to April window, and the authority has presented the scheme as a way for customers to plan itineraries with more certainty in the dry months.

Capacity not sold through the long-term scheme will continue to be allocated through the canal's ordinary reservation system and its regular auctions, the authority said.

data.title: Fulcrum Therapeutics Declares Special Cash Dividend in Connection with the Proposed Merger with Slate Medicines
data.description:
Aggregate cash dividend of up to an estimated $275.7 million, or an estimated up to $3.6095 per share

CAMBRIDGE, Mass., Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Fulcrum Therapeutics, Inc. (“Fulcrum”) today announced that its Board of Directors has declared a special cash dividend (the “Pre-Closing Cash Dividend”) in connection with the previously announced merger (the “Merger”) with Slate Medicines, Inc. (“Slate”) pursuant to the Agreement and Plan of Merger, dated August 16, 2026 (the “Merger Agreement”). The Pre-Closing Cash Dividend, which Fulcrum estimates will be an aggregate of up to approximately $275.7 million, or up to an estimated $3.6095 per share, will be payable in cash to holders of record of outstanding shares of Fulcrum common stock as of December 7, 2026. The estimated cash dividend is equal in the aggregate to an amount mutually agreed in good faith by Fulcrum and Slate by reference to the amount by which Fulcrum’s Net Cash (as determined pursuant to the Merger Agreement) is expected to exceed $20,300,000 as of the closing of the Merger. The estimated per share dividend is based on 76,381,948 shares of common stock outstanding as of November 25, 2026. The total actual distribution of the amount of the Pre-Closing Cash Dividend is scheduled to be paid to Fulcrum’s transfer agent on December 10, 2026 (the “Dividend Payment Date”), and may be higher or lower than the estimated amount. The transfer agent will distribute the Pre-Closing Cash Dividend to stockholders within a few days following the Dividend Payment Date.

Payment of the Pre-Closing Cash Dividend is subject to the final determination of Fulcrum’s Net Cash in accordance with the Merger Agreement. The estimated aggregate Pre-Closing Cash Dividend amount includes approximately $7.0 million of proceeds from the sale of Fulcrum’s early-stage fetal hemoglobin (“HbF”) assets to an unaffiliated third-party pharmaceutical company, which are expected to be funded into escrow prior to the closing of the Merger and credited to Fulcrum’s Net Cash for purposes of the Merger Agreement. The closing of the early-stage HbF assets sale is contingent upon consummation of the Merger (or in the event the Merger Agreement is terminated, upon receipt of any necessary approvals). If the anticipated $7.0 million of proceeds are not funded into escrow, the Pre-Closing Cash Dividend will be reduced to an estimated aggregate of $268.7 million, or an estimated $3.5178 per share. Closing of the Merger is expected to occur on or about December 11, 2026, assuming that the transaction is approved by Fulcrum’s stockholders and the satisfaction or waiver of all conditions under the Merger Agreement. Fulcrum’s stockholders will consider and vote upon approval of the Merger at the special meeting of Fulcrum’s stockholders scheduled for 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time on December 3, 2026.

If you need assistance voting your shares or have questions regarding the special meeting of Fulcrum’s stockholders, please contact Fulcrum’s proxy solicitor, D.F. King & Co., Inc., at (800) 431-9643 (toll-free).

About Slate Medicines, Inc.

Slate Medicines is developing next-generation therapeutics designed to expand treatment options for migraine and other headache disorders. Slate’s mission is to offer migraine patients more complete freedom from their disease than is possible with the current standard of care. Slate is advancing a portfolio of potentially best-in-class therapeutics, led by SLTE-1009, a clinical stage anti-PACAP/VIP monoclonal antibody designed to enable subcutaneous, infrequent dosing. For more information, please visit www.slatemedicines.com.

About Fulcrum Therapeutics, Inc.

Fulcrum Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company that focused on developing small molecules to improve the lives of patients with rare hematological disorders. Fulcrum used proprietary technology to identify drug targets that can modulate gene expression to treat the known root cause of genetically defined diseases. For more information, visit www.fulcrumtx.com and follow it on X (@FulcrumTx) and LinkedIn.

data.title: U.S. equities close on top on Black Friday
data.description:
Wall Street finished on top on Black Friday as the major indices posted gains following the shortened Thanksgiving holiday week.

The blue-chip Dow closed +1.1%, the benchmark S&P 500 (SP500) ended +1.6%, and the tech-focused Nasdaq Composite () finished +2.3%.

From a sector-by-sector basis, all of the 11 segments concluded in positive trading territory, with consumer discretionary leading the way higher, while utilities were the weakest area.

Moreover, the economic calendar remained light as markets closed early for the Black Friday holiday session.

"A perfect cliffhanger in equities to end Thanksgiving week. Just enough of a bounce from the spike lows to encourage bulls to chase, not enough to dissuade bears from selling. Another superb quarter will ensue at the major trading desks and market-makers alike. We're calling bull. Higher into year end," Seeking Alpha analyst Alex King of Cestrian Capital Research said.

The U.S. 2-year Treasury yield added 5 basis points to 4.70%, the U.S. 10-year Treasury yield shifted up 6 basis points to 4.93%, and the U.S. 30-year Treasury yield moved higher by 7 basis points to 5.32%.

As for other stocks that were on the move, shares of Sandisk advanced +17.1%, while shares of Vertex Pharmaceuticals dropped -5.1%.

data.title: Loblaw Companies statement on the federal government's safeguard measure on canned vegetable imports
data.description:
BRAMPTON, Ontario, Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- This is the wrong policy at the wrong time. It risks unnecessarily raising the cost of one of the most affordable sources of nutritious food when Canadian household budgets are already under significant pressure. Canadians should not be asked to pay more for essential food to unnecessarily shield a very large food processor from competition.

At Loblaw, we believe a strong and resilient Canadian food system, supported by prosperous Canadian growers and food manufacturers, is essential. Ensuring Canadians have access to lower-cost essentials when they are available is equally vital. Government policy, in our view, should balance these objectives, not advance one at the expense of the other.

data.title: Franklin Templeton Flags Hidden Risk in S&P 500 Investing
data.description:
Franklin Templeton is urging investors to rethink their stock market exposure heading into 2027, warning that excessive concentration in artificial intelligence stocks, elevated real interest rates and slowing earnings growth could create a more challenging investment environment.

However, the investment management giant isn't suggesting investors abandon technology stocks such as Nvidia , Microsoft and Alphabet . Instead, it favors spreading investments across a wider range of businesses that could benefit from the technology.

For Americans investing through their 401(k)s, the warning is particularly relevant.

Investors holding traditional S&P 500 index funds (SPY) may have considerably more exposure to megacap technology companies than they realize because of the benchmark's market-cap-weighted structure.

Franklin Templeton favors equal-weighted indexes, active stock selection and businesses that can use emerging technologies to improve operating efficiency.

The firm also warns that elevated inflation-adjusted interest rates could weigh on economic growth and stock valuations while making fixed-income investments more attractive.

High-quality government bonds could provide some protection if economic growth deteriorates or enthusiasm surrounding technology stocks fades.

Franklin Templeton also identifies opportunities across infrastructure, private credit, venture capital and private equity secondary markets.

Investors Takeaway

For retirement savers, Franklin Templeton's outlook offers a compelling reason to examine their portfolio allocations heading into 2027.

The Invesco S&P 500 Equal Weight ETF (RSP), for instance, offers exposure to the same underlying companies as the traditional S&P 500 but reduces dependence on its largest constituents.

However, reducing megacap exposure could also mean missing out on substantial gains if technology stocks regain momentum.

Investors should monitor the relative performance of equal-weighted indexes, corporate earnings revisions and inflation-adjusted Treasury yields.

The biggest takeaway from Franklin Templeton's outlook is that investors don't necessarily need to abandon the market's biggest growth story to protect themselves against its growing risks.

data.title: Corn and soybean basis mostly unchanged in Midwest

data.title: SA analyst: Bulls have the edge heading into the final weeks of 2026
data.description:
Wall Street ended the shortened Thanksgiving trading week on a positive note Friday, with all three major indexes advancing as investors looked toward the final stretch of the year.

The Dow Jones Industrial Average gained +1.1%, the S&P 500 (SP500) added +1.6% advance, while the Nasdaq Composite climbed +2.3%.

Seeking Alpha analyst Alex King of Cestrian Capital Research described the session as a pivotal moment for market sentiment, with the latest rebound offering encouragement to bullish investors without fully convincing those expecting another downturn.

“A perfect cliffhanger in equities to end Thanksgiving week,” King stated, characterizing the market’s recent price action as a delicate balance between buyers and sellers.

He argued that the recovery from recent lows has been strong enough to attract momentum-driven investors, while leaving room for skeptics to continue positioning for further weakness.

Despite the conflicting signals, King remains optimistic about the market’s near-term direction. He also suggested that heightened activity could benefit major trading desks and market-makers heading into the final weeks of the year.

“We're calling bull. Higher into year end,” King said, expressing confidence that equities can extend their gains through December.
